method_long: Execution-feedback closed-loop coordination with rotation-synchronized window guidance
note: The only configuration source of round 2 (docs/final_method/ROUND2.md): experiments/final.py launches registered configurations only. First-draft (round-1) registry: docs/archive/registry/METHOD_REGISTRY_ROUND1_20261119.json; development-period registry: docs/archive/registry/METHOD_REGISTRY_20261111.json.

ECC.role: proposed method: opportunity coordination (keep / critical-window correction / direct entry) with standard SAC

ECC_NO_CORE.role: attribution: keep and direct entry only (no grid correction)

SAC_MPC.role: w/o feedback: the policy's intent is flown as proposed (same executor, network, reward)

TD3_MPC.role: matched deterministic actor-critic baseline (TD3 standard configuration)

ECC_FB.display: ECC with execution-grounded value arbitration and equivalence experience
ECC_FB.role: feedback-mechanism candidate (docs/final_method/FEEDBACK_DEV.md): the critic ranks the executor-certified critical intents; execution-equivalent proposals share the real transition

ECC_NO_RWG.role: optional RWG ablation in the learning loop (ROUND2.md section 2): stage intents close along the line of sight, no latitude law, a_z inactive; entry rule, re-timing and coordination unchanged

nearest_arbitration.display: ECC_FB evaluated with the nearest rule
nearest_arbitration.role: paired mechanism check (FEEDBACK_DEV.md section 4): the same ECC_FB models with the first-draft nearest choice

rigid_entry.display: ECC with rigid entry commitment (no entry re-timing)
rigid_entry.role: RWG check (ROUND2.md section 2): entry re-timing off at evaluation, paired on the same models

pure.role: non-learning baseline: the frozen MPC alone, same task and truth judge

c_10_0.role: RWG check: rotation-synchronized fixed intent, no learning

b_10.role: RWG check: the same closing intent along the line of sight (geometry off), no learning
